# signal-to-system — Knowledge State

Signal to System is a professional technical publication and portfolio built with Astro, authored by Nick Miethe [source: art_01KTCNKAQ6AF9A2R38ZV9FMY6Z]. It is described as a static-first technical blog focused on AI agents, agentic SDLC, technical leadership, architecture, and platform engineering — explicitly 'a technical publication for the agentic era, authored by a practicing technical executive / builder,' not a generic blog or portfolio [source: art_01KTCNKAQ6AF9A2R38ZV9FMY6Z]. The tech stack includes Astro 6 with Content Layer API, React 19 for interactive islands, Tailwind CSS v4, MDX for content authoring, Nanostores for cross-island state, Zod for schema validation, and TypeScript in strict mode [source: art_01KTCNKAQ6AF9A2R38ZV9FMY6Z]. It is deployed via GitHub Pages with CI/CD at https://signaltosystem.com [source: art_01KTCNKAQ6AF9A2R38ZV9FMY6Z]. Three content collections exist: posts (essays/field notes), projects (portfolio artifacts), and series (multi-post sequences), all as .mdx files [source: art_01KTCNKAQ6AF9A2R38ZV9FMY6Z]. The repo serves two workflows: site development and content authoring, with external PKM directories (Blogs/, MeatyBrain/) providing research context [source: art_01KTCNKAQ6AF9A2R38ZV9FMY6Z]. The project scaffold is based on Astro's minimal starter kit template [source: art_01KTCNKAQ46Z3SHMW97T3VYB74].
